name: Microlise Group plc
summary: Microlise Group plc specializes in providing advanced technology solutions for transportation management. The company offers a comprehensive Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform engineered to digitalize the complex operational processes of large enterprises engaged in logistics. Utilizing proprietary hardware and sophisticated software, Microlise captures and meticulously analyzes real-time transport and logistics data. This capability enables fleet operators to substantially improve critical performance indicators, including operational efficiency, environmental sustainability through reduced greenhouse gas emissions, and enhanced safety compliance. Their diverse product portfolio includes: Fleet telematics: offering vehicle tracking, utilization insights, driver performance monitoring, driver communication systems, trailer telematics, and temperature control surveillance. Fleet safety solutions: featuring multi-camera surveillance and vehicle health diagnostics. Journey management tools: facilitating schedule and route planning, optimization algorithms, customer communication features, and workforce and resource allocation. Delivery management products: such as electronic proof of delivery (ePOD) and sub-contractor administration. Additionally, Microlise provides specialized devices like the Smart Gateway, designed to transmit a wide array of vehicle data to its software platform, and the DriveTab, a tablet serving as an intuitive interface for driver communication, navigation, and feedback. The company serves a broad client base of fleet operators across numerous sectors, including original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), haulage and general logistics, retail and grocery, food manufacturing, food services, pharmaceuticals, post and parcel delivery, construction, defence, and petrochemical industries. Established in 1982, Microlise Group plc is headquartered in Nottingham, United Kingdom.
